subject: Business Models
title: Labor Marketplaces
description: A fast breakdown of Labor Marketplaces for builders.

hook.text: Upwork, Fiverr, and Toptal connect 60 million freelancers to businesses worldwide. Work goes global.

buildup.text: A designer in Nigeria can compete for the same project as one in New York. Geography matters less.

discovery.text: Labor marketplaces create price transparency. Clients see global rates and choose the best value.

twist.text: Race to the bottom: global competition can suppress wages for skilled workers in expensive countries.

climax.text: Labor marketplaces will reshape employment. The question is whether they lift or suppress global wages.

punchline.text: 60 million freelancers competing globally. Where you live matters less now.

quiz.question: What is the risk of global labor marketplace competition?
options: Wage compression for workers in expensive countries
